input.summary: Add Corio termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not commit to a five-year term without an exit; we need a convenience right on 30 days' notice with a refund of prepaid fees (fallback: 60–90 days' notice). Commerce One gains no convenience right.

ops.text: 11.1A Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience.

input.summary: Extend warranty period to 12 months and delete the fixed 31 December 1999 cut-off
input.comment: [Playbook] A 60-day warranty that also expires on a fixed calendar date is below our floor of 90 days for software; we ask for 12 months, and would accept 90 days from acceptance as a fallback. The existing correction/replacement/refund remedy is unchanged.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the Effective Date (the "Warranty Period")
